bkash.heading: bKash Payment
steps: Open your bKash App and tap on 'Education Fee'
Enter your Student ID and desired payment details
Check the amount and proceed with your bKash PIN
Save the transaction ID and receipt for future reference
bkash.security_text: Always ensure you are paying to the official BAUST account. Double-check your Student ID before confirming.

bank.heading: Bank Payments
bank.text: Tuition fees can also be paid at any branch of **Trust Bank Limited**. Use the official deposit slip and ensure your details are correctly mentioned.
